commit_note: The release commit that adds this file is the child of generated_from_commit.
frozen_scientific_state: Nb_suboxide_like (Nb 3d ~205.6-205.9 eV) not validated; O 1s cross-check inconclusive
D4: Nb 3d spin-orbit splitting is calibration-sensitive for Nb2CTx
scientific_open_issues: Nb 3d ~205.7-205.9 eV component (Nb_suboxide_like) is not chemically validated; O 1s cross-check inconclusive.
Apparent M-site deficiency delta is model-dependent and provisional (candidate excluded vs counted as framework).
D4: Nb 3d spin-orbit splitting is calibration-sensitive (KB constraint 2.8 eV kept).
Ti 2p in mixed Nb/Ti samples is affected by Nb 3s overlap; interpret Ti 2p3/2 first.
O1: MAX Nb_MAX and Nb_MAX_2nd are strongly correlated; interpret their sum.
O2: provider-fraction vs Python-fraction decompositions give different delta.
O3: sample 2 provider Ti quantification is biased low (only Ti 2p3/2 fitted).
O4: sample 1 MAX M_norm = 1.00 is a numerical coincidence; not interpreted.
Sample-1 low-BE Nb 3d feature (unresolved_low_BE_Nb) is real extra intensity but non-identifiable; unassigned.
Cl 2p, S 2p and Li 1s have no validated KB fit model.
Transferred models (e.g. nbti_211_max) are not equivalent to direct literature validation.

interpretation_levels.fit_succeeded: optimizer converged and residuals are reported; says nothing about uniqueness or chemistry
interpretation_levels.statistically_identifiable: component parameters are determined by the data within this model (see identifiability status)
interpretation_levels.chemically_validated: assignment confirmed by orthogonal evidence; never claimed by this app

future_workflow: 1. Obtain a genuinely independent XPS dataset measured after this frozen release candidate.
2. Run tools/validation/holdout_first_pass.py against the frozen baseline (f466b94: app 1.6.0, KB 1.5.0).
4. Review A-D classifications before changing the KB.
5. Only after prospective validation decide whether a scientific-model revision is necessary.
